mapper.sql: select record_id, record_date, area_name, energy_kwh, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from monitor_manual_electricity
mapper.insert: insert into monitor_manual_electricity (record_date, area_name, energy_kwh, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{recordDate}, #{areaName}, #{energyKwh}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update monitor_manual_electricity set record_date = #{recordDate}, area_name = #{areaName}, energy_kwh = #{energyKwh}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where record_id = #{recordId}
